notes.title: Fiendish detective game The Case of the Golden Idol enhanced with huge update
notes.notes:
I could never hack it as a detective but I like to think my sleuthing skills have been somewhat honed through years of playing puzzle and adventure games. The true test for these faculties, other than titles like Discworld Noir or Return of the Obra Dinn, is The Case of the Golden Idol. Two years after launch and ahead of its sequel's release this detective sim has been spruced up with a brand new free upgrade that makes it much smoother to play.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Hit adventure game The Case of the Golden Idol to get big free update

notes.title: The Case of the Golden Idol - Redux update available now!
notes.notes:
Last week we announced a new update coming to The Case of the Golden Idol - called Redux. Learn more about that announcement here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1677770/view/4677641741933164088

The update is available today for all current (and future) owners of The Case of the Golden Idol. You should be prompted to update the next time you launch the game, and choose either the classic or Redux version to launch. While this update features no new playable cases or scenarios, it introduces a number of new features that make it a smoother experience overall. We understand that some players may prefer the "classic" version free of these changes, which is why we are shipping this as an optional launch parameter for all players.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677770/The_Case_of_the_Golden_Idol/

Here are some highlights from the Redux update.

[h3]12 supported languages:[/h3]
English (US)
French
Italian 
German
Spanish (Latin America)
Spanish (Spain)
Portuguese (Brazil)
Japanese
Korean 
Polish
Turkish
Chinese (Traditional)

*Chinese (Simplified) will be made available at a later date. 

[h3]New UI & Hint System[/h3]
Returning players should notice an overhaul to the UI, which should improve readability and navigation, especially at smaller resolutions. Additionally, there are now markers that indicate what objects can be interacted with, so no more guessing or using guides when you get stuck.


[h3]Steam Deck Support[/h3]
Support for Steam Deck is now in beta. In addition to running smoother, the UI and text should now scale to appropriately fit the screen size. Once the review process completes, The Case of the Golden Idol will be listed as a Verified title on the store and in your library, a process we expect to take a few weeks.

[b]For Nintendo Switch Owners[/b] - The new release of The Case of the Golden Idol: Complete Edition will need to be manually claimed on the Nintendo eShop, and is free for all current owners. This rerelease includes all of the above changes and addresses an infrequent issue that caused some players to lose all save progress.


[h2]Moving Forward[/h2]
Today, we also announced that the sequel, The Rise of the Golden Idol, will be launching on all platforms on November 12, 2024. Check out the release date trailer here for a sneak peak at what's coming next.

[previewyoutube=BlOOlkAc4N4;full][/previewyoutube]

And for those who can't wait, we also released a new extended demo ahead of Steam Next Fest, available to play right now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2716400/The_Rise_of_the_Golden_Idol/

Lastly - thank you for the ongoing support over the past couple years. We can't wait for everyone to check out The Rise of the Golden Idol when it releases next month. Wishlist, follow, tell a friend, etc.

- Team Idol

notes.title: Update Notes for September patch for the Lemurian Vampire
notes.notes:
Hey Detectives,

We have made a small patch fixing some typos and visual glitches for the Lemurian Vampire.

Thank you for reporting these issues and if you notice more, let us know!

notes.title: Small minor bug improvement patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
The following improvements are made in this patch:

2. Visual bug fixed in Scenario 2 of DLC

notes.title: Update 2023.04.25-1 DLC 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey Detectives,

We have just issued a patch in preparation for [b]Golden Idol Mysteries: The Spider of Lanka[/b]'s arrival on May 4th.

This patch adds a new button that links to the DLC's new store page. In future, this button will be used to access the new scenarios.

Please let us know [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1677770/discussions/1/]in the discussions[/url] if you run into any problems.

notes.title: Update 2022.12.05 v1.3.3
notes.notes:
Hey detectives,

The following issues are addressed in this second patch based on player feedback.

[b]Removed visual inconsistencies[/b]
A number of visual glitches were removed and some legacy visuals were updated to improve the clarity of the game.

[b]More typos fixed[/b]
A number of typos and grammar mistakes were corrected in the texts of the game.

[b]Bugs fixed[/b]
Fixed a bug where in scenario 10 one could input repeated phrases in the virtue solver and receive the correct evaluation.

Fixed a bug where in scenario 9 the incorrect phrases were given to the players in two phrase-gathering spots (although not game-breaking, the correct phrases were already given elsewhere).

notes.title: Stability fixes and text improvements - version 1.3.2
notes.notes:
Hey detectives, 

The following issues are addressed in this patch based on player feedback since the release.

[b]Hidden phrase checking[/b]
We have fixed a rare condition where a phrase may become hidden under another phrase in the inventory. The game now checks phrase positions to make sure that if any phrase overlaps another, it will move that phrase to the next free slot in the inventory.

[b]Corrupt save file detection[/b]
We’ve had rare cases where player save files were corrupted by the OS. If the game detects a corrupted save, the player will be invited to visit a helpful savegame repository with instructions on how to recover progress.

[b]Small fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed typo in Act 2 name "Cursed Inheritence" -> Inheritance
[*]Scenario 7 third letter: "brothehood" -> "brotherhood".
[*]Fixed bracket position in the epilogue brotherhood scroll for Willard Wright. (it previously went out of the paper background)
[*]Fixed that you can switch around Alistair and James' surnames in the epilogue third scroll and still be correct.
[*]Fixed that if you are zoomed in, the screen position is broken when you return to the scenario selection screen.
[*]Added hyphens to the will text in the 3rd Scenario. Should be “My late sister - your mother - …”
[/list]

Please feel free to let us know your feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1677770/discussions/0/]discussions[/url] or in our [url=https://discord.gg/2kDZAxbKuC]Discord[/url].
